note: Read whole (99 pages, mostly indicator tables). The plan describes IECMS only as streamlining court processes and never says that police or RIB stations and posts enter reports or cases in it, so it has no class and gives no fact. If another document makes IECMS the record system, this is a current sector plan (October 2024, covering 2024/25 to 2028/29, RWF 921.1 billion in all, RWF 85.6 billion for the technology outcome) that names its upgrade; it also plans 1,421 investigators for RIB stations and posts and gives 33 district police units and police stations constructed at baseline, 58 targeted.
